title: Fix File not found, cause 3: template style file

scenes.narration: Cause three: a style file from a template is not in the project folder.
scenes.caption: A template style file is missing.

scenes.narration: Conference and journal style files are not part of any TeX distribution. Here the log names neurips underscore twenty twenty six dot S T Y.

scenes.narration: Copy the S T Y, C L S and B S T files from the template next to your main dot tex.
